original_test_intent: Modify access for one dedicated BMC test account and validate least-privilege behavior, exact readback, credential safety and full restoration.
original_method: Do not guess user-access fields; require account/channel scope, secret handling, complete baseline, approval, effective-login checks, rotation and rollback.
manual_activity: Vendor/security owner defines exact fields and a dedicated least-privilege account; operator validates protected secrets and independent admin recovery.

command_applicability.command_recommendation: None until vendor semantics and credential-safe rollback are approved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Baseline one dedicated account, apply one least-privilege change, read every field, verify bounded authorization, rotate/restore secrets and confirm no unrelated user changed.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds missing security contract without editing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only checks cannot replace user-access mutation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong user or field can grant admin rights, expose credentials or lock out recovery.

project_override_considerations: Any API must target the same dedicated account and provide equivalent access/readback/secret-rotation/rollback coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title requires a credential/security mutation but Procedure and Criteria are TBD; clearing logs conflicts with mandatory audit evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: User target, access fields and credential lifecycle define the operation and cannot be invented as runtime details.

review_improvement: Prevents undefined privilege/account changes and keeps the required write, effective-access and restoration coverage explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: Set User Access can alter privilege, channel eligibility and credential state. Without a dedicated identity and exact field/secret semantics, even one write could compromise recovery or create unauthorized access, so security engineering must decide first.
